subject: sinhala
edition: EPD Grade 6 'Sinhala Bhashava ha Sahithyaya' textbook (1st print 2014, 6th print 2019; edupub file dated 2019-09-20), syllabus from 2015; NIE Teacher's Guide 1st ed. 2015. Pre-reform materials, which are the official ones for 2026 because the Grade 6 reform was put back to 2027.

concepts.title_en: Folk tale: How Nari Naide was fooled (listening and responding)
outcomes: Explain what folk lore is and name its main forms (folk tales, proverbs, folk poems)
Listen to a folk tale and retell the main events in order
Answer questions about a story heard and give a personal response
Notice that the story uses older spoken words and explain their meaning
concepts.guideRef: Competency 1.0, level 1.1 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 29; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Poem: Udaya Siri (listening to and enjoying children's poetry)
outcomes: Listen attentively to a set of verses and say what they are about
Identify the theme of a poem and explain it simply
Point out rhyme and rhythm and how they make a poem easy to recite
Show interest in reading and reciting other poems
concepts.guideRef: Competency 1.0, level 1.3 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 31; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Let's write poems (simple verse composition)
outcomes: Choose a suitable theme for a short poem
Match words so that lines rhyme and keep a steady rhythm
Use simple figures of speech such as comparisons
Write and recite a short original poem
concepts.guideRef: Competency 12.0, level 12.1 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 58; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Sri Lanka's Vedda people: life, beliefs and language
outcomes: Name the Veddas as the indigenous people of Sri Lanka
Describe main features of traditional Vedda life and beliefs from the reading
Recognise a few Vedda-language words and what they mean
Show respect for cultures different from one's own
concepts.guideRef: Competency 9.0, level 9.4 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 53; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Speaking on a topic clearly and politely
concepts.unit: 3. චුචෙං චුලඟෙං යමු කිරි නෑනෝ - මාතෘකානුකූල කතා
outcomes: Plan a short talk with a beginning, middle and end
Speak clearly with good voice control and without hesitation
Adjust language to the listener (parents, relatives, friends, clergy) and stay courteous
Hold the attention of an audience
concepts.guideRef: Competency 1.0, levels 1.6 and 1.2 (5 + 5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 30, 33; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Greeting cards
concepts.unit: 3. චුචෙං චුලඟෙං යමු කිරි නෑනෝ - සුබ පැතුම් පත්
outcomes: List the basic features of a greeting card (sender, receiver, short heartfelt message)
Choose wording that suits the relationship with the receiver
Design and write a creative greeting card
concepts.guideRef: Competency 7.0, level 7.2 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 47; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Personal letters
concepts.unit: 3. චුචෙං චුලඟෙං යමු කිරි නෑනෝ - පෞද්ගලික ලිපි
outcomes: Recognise the layout of a personal letter (address and date, greeting, body, closing)
Write a personal letter that follows that layout
Choose a tone that suits the person written to
concepts.guideRef: Competency 7.0, level 7.1 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 46; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: The Sinhala alphabet and vowel signs (pili)
outcomes: Write the Sinhala alphabet in the correct order
Group letters into vowels and consonants
Name the vowel signs (pili) and use them correctly
Form letters with the correct shape and size
concepts.guideRef: Competency 3.0, level 3.1 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 37; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Nouns and their forms (number, case: subject/non-subject, gender)
outcomes: Identify nouns in sentences
Change nouns between singular and plural
Tell subject (ukta) forms from non-subject (anukta) forms
Classify nouns by gender and use them correctly in sentences
concepts.guideRef: Competency 6.0, level 6.1 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 43; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Poem on good customs (values through reading)
outcomes: Read verses about good habits and explain what each recommends
Discuss why good customs are worth keeping
Relate the values in the poem to daily life
concepts.guideRef: Competency 9.0, level 9.2 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 51; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Reading aloud: The Elephant Danger (Kumaratunga Munidasa)
outcomes: Read a passage aloud with clear and correct pronunciation
Control voice and pause at punctuation while reading
Read with understanding and answer questions on the passage
Practise difficult sounds with pronunciation drills
concepts.guideRef: Competency 2.0, level 2.1 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 34; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Vocabulary: synonyms, antonyms and adjectives
concepts.unit: 7. අලි උවදුර - විශේෂණ පද (also 16. - විශේෂණ පද, p. 105)
outcomes: Identify synonyms, antonyms and adjectives
Add suitable adjectives to nouns
Use synonyms, antonyms and adjectives correctly in writing
concepts.guideRef: Competency 5.0, level 5.1 (6 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 41; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Nalapana Jataka: reading in different styles
outcomes: Recognise different writing styles (classical prose, drama)
Read a Jataka story in an appropriate, listenable style
Read a drama extract in character
Appreciate how the reading style brings out the flavour of a text
concepts.guideRef: Competency 2.0, level 2.2 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 35; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Spelling: aspirated letters, prenasalised letters and na/na, la/la
concepts.unit: 8. නලපාන ජාතකය - මහාප්‍රාණ අක්ෂර, සඤ්ඤක අක්ෂර
outcomes: Tell unaspirated (alpaprana) from aspirated (mahaprana) letters and use them correctly
Use prenasalised (sannaka) letters correctly in words
Choose correctly between letters that sound the same (na/na, la/la)
concepts.guideRef: Competency 3.0, level 3.3 (6 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 38; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Verbs and their forms; word classes and word division
outcomes: Name the three word classes: nouns, verbs and particles (nipata)
Separate words correctly when writing
Classify verbs by number, person, gender and tense
Use verb forms correctly in practical writing
concepts.guideRef: Competency 6.0, level 6.2 (6 periods); Competency 4.0, level 4.2 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 40, 44; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Building sentences (subject-verb agreement)
outcomes: Make the verb agree with the subject in number, person and gender
Use the correct tense in sentences
Build sentences with subject, object and predicate in the right relationship
Value correct sentence rules in writing
concepts.guideRef: Competency 6.0, level 6.5 (8 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 45; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Kala Wewa: tanks and the culture around them
outcomes: Gather facts about irrigation tanks from a reading (Brohier, translated)
Explain the cultural customs and beliefs linked to the tank
Use this knowledge in study and creative work
Value the irrigation heritage of Sri Lanka
concepts.guideRef: Competency 9.0, level 9.1 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 50; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Writing essays on a topic
concepts.unit: 11. කලා වැවට පින් දීලා පලයල්ලා - මාතෘකානුකූල රචනා ලිවීම
outcomes: Choose a topic and gather points for it
Plan an essay with an introduction, body and conclusion
Organise points logically and write in suitable language
Check spelling, word division and punctuation
concepts.guideRef: Competency 8.0, level 8.1 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 48; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Silent reading: The Walking Leaf (Martin Wickramasinghe)
outcomes: Read silently and understand a popular-science story
Explain the technical words in the text
Present the information gathered from reading
Value the habit of reading widely
concepts.guideRef: Competency 2.0, level 2.3 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 36; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Punctuation marks
outcomes: Name the full stop, comma, question mark, exclamation mark and single/double quotation marks
Use punctuation correctly so that writing is clear
Use full stops to mark abbreviations
concepts.guideRef: Competency 4.0, level 4.1 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 39; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Traditional food of old Sri Lanka (from Robert Knox)
outcomes: Describe food and food-preparation knowledge of Kandyan-era Sri Lanka
Name old food types and the customs linked to them
Recognise and use language expressions related to food
concepts.guideRef: Competency 10.0, level 10.2 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 55; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Folk poems (cart-driver's songs)
outcomes: Explain what folk poetry is and how it differs from learned poetry
Describe the life experiences behind the folk poems
Explain the culture reflected in the poems
Value folk poetry as part of Sinhala literature
concepts.guideRef: Competency 11.0, level 11.2 (6 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 57; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Classical poetry: Kavyashekharaya and Guttila Kavyaya
outcomes: Place the poems in the Kotte period of Sinhala poetry
Explain the human experiences described in the verses
Find comparisons (similes) and descriptions in the verses
Explain the meaning of key words from the verses
concepts.guideRef: Competency 11.0, level 11.1 (4 periods, shared with Unit 19); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 56; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Proverbs and the stories behind them
concepts.title_si: මරණ තුනක් ඇති මිනිසෙක් පැණි කෑ ය
concepts.unit: 16. මරණ තුනක් ඇති මිනිසෙක් පැණි කෑ ය
outcomes: Explain what a proverb (prastava pirula) is
Retell the story behind a proverb
Use proverbs suitably in speech and writing
concepts.guideRef: Competency 5.0, level 5.2 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 42; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: A writer's childhood: K. Jayatilake (autobiography)
outcomes: Present facts about the writer's life from the reading
Identify the skills and qualities that made him a writer
Name lessons that can be learned from his life
Explain what an autobiography is
concepts.guideRef: Competency 10.0, level 10.1 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 54; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Patriotic song: Vasanavan (W. A. Abeysinghe)
outcomes: Explain the ideas in a patriotic song in simple words
Name the natural resources and beauty of the country described
Comment on the poetic features of the song
Enjoy and value patriotic literature
concepts.guideRef: Competency 9.0, level 9.3 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 52; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Folk tale: the watchman scolded by Rasin Deiyo
outcomes: Identify the human experiences in a folk tale
Explain the life lessons the story brings out
Collect other folk tales from the community
concepts.guideRef: Competency 11.0, level 11.1 (4 periods, shared with Unit 15); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 56; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Writing creative stories
concepts.unit: 19. රාසිං දෙයියන්ට බැණ වැදුණ මුරකරුවා - නිර්මාණාත්මක ප්‍රබන්ධ රචනා
outcomes: Pick situations and events that make a good story
Build characters and events that follow logically
Write a short, engaging story of one's own
concepts.guideRef: Competency 12.0, level 12.2 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 59; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Listening for information: a radio programme on a solar eclipse
outcomes: Listen attentively to a radio programme and note key facts
Recall and present the information heard
Separate scientific facts from folk beliefs about an eclipse
Use the gathered information in suitable situations
concepts.guideRef: Competency 1.0, level 1.4 (5 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 32; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Wall newspaper and magazine articles
concepts.title_si: බිත්ති පුවත්පත් ලිපි හා සඟරා ලිපි
concepts.unit: 20. සූරිය උදා වී යළි සැඟවුණාදෝ - බිත්ති පුවත්පත් ලිපි, සඟරා ලිපි
outcomes: Describe the special features of wall-newspaper and magazine writing
Write a clear, attractive article for a class wall newspaper or magazine
Present ideas so that they catch the reader's interest
concepts.guideRef: Competency 8.0, level 8.2 (4 periods); TG lesson guidance PDF p. 49; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27

concepts.title_en: Enemy and friend: a historical story and writing dialogue
outcomes: Read a historical story from Kumaratunga Munidasa's Prabandhopadeshaya and explain its message
Identify the basic features of written dialogue
Choose a suitable incident and write a dialogue between characters
Use language that suits a play script
concepts.guideRef: Competency 12.0, level 12.3 (4 periods); also 11.1; TG lesson guidance PDF p. 56, 60; syllabus grid TG PDF pp. 16-27
